questions.stem: A jacket costs 85 pounds. It is reduced by 20% in a sale. What is the sale price?
questions.explanation: 20% of 85 = 0.2 x 85 = 17. Sale price = 85 - 17 = 68 pounds. Alternatively, 80% of 85 = 0.8 x 85 = 68.

After a 12% increase, a worker's salary is 33,600 pounds. What was the original salary?
questions.explanation: After a 12% increase, the salary is 112% of the original. So original = 33,600 / 1.12 = 30,000 pounds. A common error is calculating 33,600 x 0.88 = 29,568 (subtracting 12% from the new amount instead).

questions.stem: A car depreciates by 15% each year. It was bought for 12,000 pounds. What is it worth after 2 years?
questions.explanation: Each year the car retains 85% of its value. After 2 years: 12,000 x 0.85 x 0.85 = 12,000 x 0.7225 = 8,670 pounds. A common error is subtracting 15% twice from the original (giving 8,400).
